cohort: A cohort of 34 infants admitted to a level III neonatal intensive care unit at Brigham and Women's Hospital who received an initial 1-Tesla MRI and a repeat 3-Tesla MRI within 14 days.
finding: 1-Tesla magnetic resonance imaging was sufficient for characterizing a wide range of neonatal brain injuries and abnormalities, and subsequent 3-Tesla magnetic resonance imaging did not provide additional clinical benefit.
